guest_post.goal: Contribute an original article useful to a relevant publisher's audience.
qualify: Publisher covers this audience
Recent editorial activity
Published contribution route or explicit editor interest
Proposed topic adds material the site lacks
reject: Required payment hidden from campaign owner
Mass-produced guest-post inventory without editorial review
agent_work: Use the existing email tool when outreach is authorized
guest_post.success: Published article contains an accurate, contextually useful attribution to the target asset.

resource_addition.goal: Help a resource-page editor add a genuinely useful missing resource.
qualify: Page curates outside resources
Our asset fills an observable gap
Page's audience matches the asset
Publisher has a working submission route
evidence: Relevant section and current neighboring resources
Specific missing information our asset supplies
reject: The target duplicates an existing resource without improvement
Resource is mainly a sales page with little independent utility
agent_work: Record editor response using external message IDs
resource_addition.success: The editor adds the resource to a relevant section, then an independent check verifies the placement.

broken_link.goal: Offer an accurate replacement for a demonstrably unavailable cited resource.
qualify: Repeated checks establish unavailability rather than blocking
Replacement answers the original citation's purpose
Replacement claims have evidence
reject: A single timeout or bot challenge treated as dead
Historical source unavailable but replacement accuracy unverified
broken_link.success: The editor repairs the citation using a suitable destination and monitoring confirms the result.

competitor.goal: Find relevant publisher opportunities from observed competitor placements.
qualify: Placement is editorially relevant
Our offering independently merits inclusion
Source remains active
There is a real route to contribute or request correction
evidence: Provider or owned-index provenance and retrieval time
reject: Competitor link is assumed to guarantee our eligibility
Provider disappearance treated as confirmed link loss
competitor.success: A qualified, evidence-backed opportunity becomes an earned, independently verified placement.

reclamation.goal: Repair a previously earned link or request useful attribution for an existing mention.
qualify: Prior link or relevant mention has evidence
Change is confirmed rather than an inaccessible page
Correct destination helps the reader
reject: Unknown fetch outcome described as intentional removal
Attribution request presented as a legal demand without a basis
agent_work: Check whether our own destination changed
Use the prior thread when available
reclamation.success: The placement is repaired or useful attribution is added, with the outcome recorded locally.

custom.goal: Define a campaign around the user's actual product, assets and audience.
qualify: State why a publisher and its reader benefit
Define observable acceptance and rejection criteria
Specify what evidence is required
reject: Invented contact details or publisher policies
agent_work: Write a product-specific goal and rubric in campaign notes
Adapt available research, browser and email tools
Track outcomes using the common CRM entities
custom.success: Campaign-specific acceptance criteria are met and supported by verifiable evidence.
